pages.text: Mount an $(item)Industrial Pipe$() on an engine block and the engine refuels itself from a fluid tank touching that block, on any of its six sides. Create fluid tanks and TFMG steel tanks both work, including multiblock tanks.

$(li)Every half second it moves up to $(item)500 mB$() of fuel into the engine.$(li)It only moves $(item)what the engine accepts$(). If the engine already holds a different fluid, or its 4000 mB tank is full, nothing leaves the tank.

Since 1.3.0 the upgrade asks the engine first and drains only that amount. Before, it could drain fuel the engine refused and void it, and a full source tank never fed anything.$(br2)The upgrade finds a new tank by itself when you place or replace one next to the engine. Place the tank against the block that carries the pipe, not against another block of the row.
